Partners are now attached to a large and fast-growing share of Anthropic's biggest enterprise deals. Your job is to make those partnerships deliver more every quarter.

Our scaled programs team supports the rest of the partner network. You'll focus on the partners where hands-on marketing moves the most business, and use those scaled programs where they fit.

Partner Marketing Strategy & Execution

Develop joint campaigns and executive programs (CXO dinners, executive briefings, tentpole event activations) aimed at C-suite and senior decision-makers at enterprise customers
Work with Partner Account Managers and the Alliances team to identify priority accounts and build account-based plays that leverage partner relationships
Lead joint announcements from first draft through approvals, holding partner copy to Anthropic's messaging and brand standards
Spot RSIs gaining traction and help them grow into higher tiers
Content, Proof & Enablement
Build joint value propositions, messaging, and enablement materials (pitch decks, solution briefs, case studies) that help partners position Claude with their enterprise clients
Turn partner deliveries into proof: capture wins for sellers, and work with Customer Marketing to produce partner-led customer stories that meet each partner's tier requirements

Are skilled at developing joint value propositions that articulate clear business outcomes for enterprise customers

Have 7+ years of marketing experience, with significant focus on partner marketing in B2B technology environments

Your safety matters to us.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Global O2C Strategy & Transformation

Build the operating metrics and reporting that make O2C performance legible to leadership — cycle times, error and rework rates, touchless transaction rates, revenue leakage, and cost to serve

Build the operational infrastructure that lets the function absorb order-of-magnitude growth without a proportional increase in headcount

Systems, Automation & AI

Deploy AI and automation to drive real leverage across the function — automated exception handling and reconciliation, self-service reporting and anomaly detection, and continuous rather than sample-based control monitoring

Your role is pivotal in designing, architecting, and deploying advanced ML models that translate raw sensor data into actionable driving behaviors, enabling vehicles to robustly navigate diverse real-world scenarios and conditions. You'll lead critical technical initiatives, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, mentor ML engineers, and significantly shape the future of onboard ML capabilities. The Onboard Embodied AI team is at the forefront of developing groundbreaking onboard ML systems powering fully autonomous vehicles. We leverage modern end-to-end machine learning approaches with sophisticated neural networks trained from large-scale driving data and using state-of-the-art alignment approaches. Our solutions enable vehicles to understand complex, dynamic driving environments, handle uncertainty gracefully, and adapt seamlessly to changing conditions. Join a collaborative and innovative team redefining autonomy through state-of-the-art machine learning, delivering solutions that move beyond current technological boundaries. Strong software engineering proficiency, particularly Python and C++, alongside extensive hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX). jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Senior individual-contributor role on the Architecture and Components team; works alongside a multidisciplinary group (UI, UX, AI Engineering, Full Stack, Architecture) within a globally distributed organization. This role does not manage people. Organizational Context As BMS Product Development & Supply (PDS) accelerates delivery of digital products and digital workers through Fusion Teams and scales adoption via Intelligence Hub, the organization requires clear ownership of architecture, reusable components, and technical decision-rights. The Analytics & AI Enablement (A&AIE) Architecture & Components Team is a highly technical team responsible for defining how digital solutions are built, ensuring they are scalable, operable, and future-ready through PDS Aim Points, with ambitions to revolutionize PDS use of AI by 2030–2035. Rather than delivering individual use cases, this team establishes and stewards the shared architectural foundations and components — including those used for the foundational data pipelines, analytical models, and business-facing reports and dashboards — that enable broad, consistent execution across PDS. Position Summary This senior individual-contributor role will architect and build the shared, full-stack platform that powers analytics, digital products, and digital workers across PDS. The role focuses on distributed, multi-service systems that combine an orchestration layer, autonomous agents, shared services, and a federated frontend into a single internal platform-as-a-service — treated as reusable foundations rather than one-off use cases. You will work end to end, from async backend services and APIs through to modern web frontends, and you will design platforms that go beyond conversational interfaces to deliver autonomous analytical workflows, standardized tool-calling, and composable UI experiences. This is a deeply hands-on, principal-level technical authority role; you set the bar through architecture, reference implementations, and engineering excellence. Key Responsibilities Platform & Multi-Service System Architecture Architect distributed, multi-service platforms that orchestrate work across autonomous services and agents, with conditional routing, parallel execution, and error recovery. Design the platform as an internal SaaS/PaaS: shared SDKs, service contracts, and reusable components that solution teams consume rather than rebuild. Build graph-based orchestration workflows combining LLM reasoning, business logic, real-time data integration, and enterprise security patterns. Create reusable node/component libraries and extensible platform patterns supporting multiple business domains. Backend Development & API Design Build production FastAPI (or similar) applications with async I/O patterns for persistence and external services. Implement Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSocket protocols for real-time streaming responses. Design APIs and event-driven architectures for orchestration and service-to-service communication. Develop robust error handling, graceful degradation, and enterprise security integration (SSO, access control), deploying containerized services via CI/CD. Frontend & Unified Experience Build modern web frontends (e.g., React) and design micro-frontend / Module Federation composition so independently built modules form one coherent experience. Develop and steward a shared component library and design system used across the platform. Design AI-enhanced UI patterns for streaming responses, chat, and analytical/canvas visualization. MCP Development & Dual-Intent Delivery Make MCP development and hosting a first-class platform capability, ensuring every solution is dual-intent: delivered both as a full-stack web experience and through Claude Desktop. Design, build, and host production MCP servers that expose platform services and tools so the same underlying capabilities power both the web UI and Claude Desktop, with no divergence between the two surfaces. Define golden-path patterns, templates, and shared MCP servers (tools, resources, prompts, transport, and authentication) that solution teams reuse to ship dual-intent solutions quickly. Establish MCP hosting, versioning, security, and operational standards for seamless, enterprise-grade integration with Claude Desktop. LLM Integration, Orchestration & Tool Calling Integrate cloud LLM providers (AWS Bedrock or comparable) into platform services. Design prompt management with versioning, templating, and dynamic compilation. Implement conversation/state persistence (e.g., Redis checkpointing) for multi-turn workflows. Build standardized tool-calling that connects agents and external clients to data sources and services, with the Model Context Protocol as the primary integration surface. Reusability, Observability & Optimization Treat internal developers as customers: provide golden-path templates, clear contracts, and documentation that accelerate delivery. Define standards for versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility across the component ecosystem. Integrate observability and tracing; build monitoring for performance, latency, cost, and quality, and optimize resource and token usage across production workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with cloud, AI, data, and UX engineers on the team to integrate full-stack work with infrastructure, agentic capabilities, and interaction design. Partner with Enterprise engineering and governance teams to align standards, controls, and shared services. Provide technical mentorship on solution patterns, system design, and platform best practices, and contribute to architecture reviews and documentation. Desired Experience | Required Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related field. 6+ years of software engineering experience with deep full-stack delivery, including production experience building LLM-powered or agentic applications. Strong Python, including async patterns (asyncio, async/await) and Python-based automation. Production experience with async web frameworks (FastAPI or similar), REST, and event-driven / streaming architectures (WebSocket/SSE, queues, streams). Strong working knowledge of modern web frontends (React) and micro-frontend / Module Federation composition; deep frontend and design-system expertise a strong plus. Experience designing distributed, multi-service systems with well-defined contracts between components, and building an internal platform, SaaS/PaaS, or shared developer platform. Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks (LangGraph preferred; LangChain, CrewAI, Autogen, or similar) and integration with cloud LLM providers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenAI) , including onboarding and standardizing these frameworks for solution teams . Strong platform and cloud depth: Docker and Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation), Git and CI/CD, service mesh, policy-as-code (OPA/Gatekeeper), and production observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) on AWS (Azure and/or GCP a plus). Experience owning platform governance, security, and self-service onboarding for a shared platform — IAM/SSO, group-based authorization, and policy-as-code — acting as a technical gatekeeper for the teams that consume it. Critical Platform & Agentic Systems Experience Built autonomous, multi-step systems performing analytical tasks beyond simple chatbots. Designed distributed platforms with service orchestration, conditional logic, and state management. Developed and hosted production MCP servers with demonstrated adoption across capabilities. Delivered dual-intent solutions where the same services power both a web experience and an LLM/desktop client via MCP. Implemented standardized tool-calling for external system integration. Designed shared SDKs/contracts and managed API/contract evolution across many consumers. Prompt engineering at scale (templating, versioning, optimization) and understanding of agentic design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, tool-use agents). Strong problem-solving, communication, and ability to set technical direction and influence in globally distributed teams. Ideal Candidates Would Also Have Prior experience in global life sciences, pharma, or supply chain — especially in Product Development & Supply (PDS). Experience in regulated environments (GxP, GDPR, PII) and embedding compliance into platform design. Experience scaling an internal platform across multiple product/domain teams and managing the resulting contract and dependency surface. Experience working internationally with globally dispersed teams. Other Qualifications Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority. Hands-on experience implementing Agentic AI solutions and/or MCP is preferred. Relevant cloud certification (e.g., AWS) is a plus. jobs.description: As a Site Procurement Manager for the Amazon Fulfillment Center team, you will serve as the bridge between centralized Procurement and the building leadership. You will own the site’s indirect procurement operation responsibilities at a site level, including vendor management of 3rd party service providers, purchase order management, and inventory management. You will lead supplier management KPI and metrics reporting, and work with stakeholders to find and understand deviation and improvement areas. You will provide procurement leadership and align with the building leadership team to drive efficiencies and improvements at the site(s). Key job responsibilities • Provide procurement operations support for fulfillment centers, including managing suppliers (goods and services), non-inventory labor, flow and space models, cycle counts, inventory management, and procurement transactions. • Ensure compliance with organizational KPIs, working with the non-inventory team to measure, control, and benchmark procurement processes. • Develop expertise in non-inventory items and collaborate with similar buildings to implement best practices. • Build relationships across the network, ensuring the sharing and implementation of best practices. This includes training teams such as Operations, Loss Prevention, PXT, Transportation, Facilities Management, and Safety on procurement processes. • Work with internal teams, Finance, and Procurement Operations to understand budgetary targets and establish methods for measuring savings, value, and category metrics. • Assist Finance and internal teams in determining budgets and managing blanket POs. • Monitor supplier performance using tools such as supplier scorecards and Global Audit Tools for 3P suppliers. Collaborate with Category and Global Supplier Management to drive improvements across categories like janitorial, food service, pest control, landscaping, snow removal, water coolers, PPE, and waste management. • Ensure 3P suppliers comply with site-level contracts and service terms, including SLA response times. • Track and measure savings performance, developing action plans to meet goals and reduce waste in FC procurement processes. Standardize best practices across the network. • Collaborate with both internal teams and suppliers to develop innovative procurement solutions that support Operations. • Implement methods to track supplier performance and drive continuous improvement. • Partner with AP, suppliers, and internal teams to resolve vendor payment issues promptly. • Support Procure-to-Pay execution and local sourcing activities to meet business needs. • Assist the centralized Procurement team (GPCS) and Global Procurement Organization (GPO) pillars, including ProcOps, Category, Supplier Diversity, Supplier Management, Procurement Excellence, Reusables, Technology, and PMO. • Work in a warehouse environment, requiring frequent walking and adaptability to varying temperatures due to open dock doors. • Other responsibilities as assigned by your manager • This position requires regular travel to assigned site(s); travel distances may exceed 50 miles depending on business needs.
